areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Program addresses public-space quality, protection of green areas, flooding and climate-change mitigation.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Together with 1.7 and 1.8, addresses precarious culture, tourism and market services, aiming at more formalized vendors and firms.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Grouped with 1.6 and 1.8: indicators on regularized vendors and formalized firms in the central area.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Grouped with 1.6 and 1.7: more opportunities, jobs and income from the market and tourism revitalization.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Culture and tourism facilities, requalified market and public spaces, accessibility and mobility benefiting low-income users.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Residents of the central district treated as a social minority benefiting from the business, jobs and service improvements.
